title: Cracking Consciousness Study With Monroe & Neuphoria (Cohort 2&3)
official: Cracking Consciousness Study With Monroe & Neuphoria (Cohort 2&3)
summary: In partnership with Monroe, this EEG neurofeedback study is looking at the efficacy of Neuphoria with Monroe for mental clarity and well-being.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Can read and understand English.
* US resident.
* Willing and able to follow the requirements of the protocol.

Exclusion Criteria:

* Individuals with severe mental health disorders
* Individuals with low frustration tolerance
* Individuals without access to emergency medical care
* Individuals involved in regulated professions
* Individuals with skepticism towards digital monitoring
* Individuals without a support system
